summary.name: Upscayl
summary.one_liner: Upscayl is a free, open-source AI image upscaler that enlarges and sharpens blurry or low-resolution photos, available for Linux, macOS and Windows.
use_cases: Batch upscaling several images at once
summary.what_it_does: Upscayl uses AI models to increase image resolution, with the page claiming upscaling up to 16x. It offers multiple models for different needs, and the page says it aims to preserve details and colors. Batch processing lets several images be upscaled in one go, and the page mentions AI face enhancement and detail recovery. The desktop app is described as available for Linux, macOS and Windows, and the page also mentions mobile and tablet availability.
notable: Upscales up to 16x using multiple AI models
Batch processing of several images at once
caveats: Page does not give specifics on mobile or tablet apps beyond general claims of availability
Page is mostly marketing; performance claims such as '10x faster' are unverified
Page lists 'describe your vision' AI image generation features that are not clearly part of the upscaler itself
